findings.rule: Normalize native paths before architecture and inventory matching
findings.trigger: Windows source paths contain single backslashes; the previous raw-string replacement matched two backslashes.
findings.impact: Architecture rules could miss Windows dependencies and the coverage inventory would disagree with normalized source paths.
findings.recommendation: Use the shared repositoryPath normalization and retain the explicit Windows-path regression. The final implementation and independently executed nine-test architecture suite satisfy this recommendation.

findings.rule: Mechanically enforce the documented commit-title convention
findings.trigger: A pull request previously had no invocation of the existing commit-check capability.
findings.impact: Invalid squash-commit titles could pass the declared Git governance workflow.
findings.recommendation: Validate pull request titles using an environment variable and quoted argument rather than expression interpolation into shell code. The final workflow implements this and includes edited-title events.

findings.rule: Keep CI callers compatible with typed just recipe interfaces
findings.trigger: The UI report recipe changed to one manifest parameter while CI still passed --manifest plus the path as two parameters.
findings.impact: Every visual-change pull request would fail before the UI evidence checker ran.
findings.recommendation: Call just ui-report .governance/ui.json and update the matching documentation. The corrected invocation passes an independent just dry run.

findings.rule: Do not depend on native empty-argument forwarding in Windows PowerShell
findings.trigger: Default coverage and changes recipes previously emitted --base followed by an empty quoted argument.
findings.impact: Windows PowerShell native argument handling could omit the empty value and leave the Go flag without a value.
findings.recommendation: Omit the entire --base fragment when no explicit base is supplied. Final recipes do so and local dry runs confirm the default and explicit-argument forms.

limitations: The reviewer authored the shared currency migration and removal of tool/check_currencies.py; those changes are excluded from this independent approval. The root agent separately verified byte-for-byte currency export parity, and another reviewer reviewed the shared implementation.
